reviews.review_title: as of right now, DO NOT GET THIS GAME!
reviews.review_description:
This game is extremely buggy, I'm aware that the game just came out, but at least fix the bugs that new players won't run into on and on. When I firstly load into tutorial, I try to follow the grabbing mechanic, OOPS! I walk into a wall, matter of fact you can walk into any wall, and the tutorial was pretty confusing for the most part. And don't get me started with the backpack system, with or without the already confusing tutorial, it's still super hard to actually use the backpack how you want to use it. And the movement, I hate it. Super jiggly movement physics make it almost impossible to enjoy the game, as well as everything being slippery in the base game. Also why is the debug menu just clicking a button twice? I was SUPER confused what was going on. 
The studio UK lacks originality, I mean facility apes 3, it was fun, yet it was basically a 1 to 1 copy of a flat screen game but with gtag physics, and this game, is just "PEAK",, but this time it was more HEAVILY inspired then straight up almost stealing.

TLDR;
 extremely confusing
Buggy
Tutorial didn't really teach a lot
Bad/jiggly movement 
Accidental debug menu opening
PLEASE BUY THIS A LITTLE AFTERWARDS, I FIND THIS GAME UNPLAYABLE AS OF JUNE 20th

-For the devs, 
I mean no pure hatred towards you guys, I like how you give more "life" to games that already exist, and so people that don't already have a flat screen for games could play (if that's your goal), I just want a enjoyable experience for a game that first released, I hope you fix these, or just change it I guess. Anyways, I'll be getting my 4$ back. Goodbye.
I will eat a cookie every time someone likes this review

ok, so as a big fan of climbing, i am here to tell some things
first, its not much of a horror, if you dont fear heights ( why would you even buy it then)
secondly, im amazed by how they recreated peak style, as a big fan of peak also love this
ok now pluses and minuses
minuses: lags when you play, i know it might be for optimisation but still could ruin runs, gripping - also pretty annoying, because you need to click perfectly when your hand sticks the wall, also encountered alot of multiplayer glitches and bugs, like disconnecting, and walking thru walls 
pluses: fun mechanics that basically alternates from peak but still are fun, stamina, firstly i thought that fall damage was small, but when played alot, realised it isnt,but the hunger i think is pretty small, also cool that you still can give your friends help, but it doesnt work that great
the game is only a month old, so allat might be fixed, so for now, i actually recommend buying the game, and its also just 4.00
i hope the game will get as popular as fa3
anyways all i wanted to say
